clarifications_accepted_by_parent: Owner history READ/PREPARE does not require current EXECUTE; new business writes do.
Ordinary has no provider one-hour lifetime. History/OPEN/MARK_READ/WITHDRAW do not inherit offer expiry; ACCEPT/SUBMIT/ACK retain the original 300-second deadline and generation checks.

Per-operation local immutable participant context; no participants stored on shared ordinary service. Persisted current active/inactive assignments and Native history are checked; no claim to detect trusted-admin history deletion.
counts_note: 18 oracle specifications and planned designs are not test executions or PASS counts.
method: Literal expected states/access/side effects from original requirements, contract and baseline only; no new implementation-derived oracle, project import, algorithm clone or execution.
planned_bounded_composites: fresh configured_app and original worker processes preserve exact original deadline/UUID/timestamps
two simultaneous Cases do not leak mutable participant context
revoke/restore then restart cannot revive stale generation
old isolated/native/assignment exclusion with no foreign queue takeover
owned lock wait crosses original deadline and rolls back new action
shared API/worker mode routing, default and invalid/mixed configuration
scope_limitations: No tests, DB, worker/server/browser/model process or network started by reviewer
No real source or business authority issued

specifications.boundary: No identity, Grant, policy, permit, approval or credential is issued by configuration.
specifications.expected: Unset mode retains the original guard. Exact CURRENT_PREPARATION selects the same admission configuration for API and worker. Unknown/noncanonical mode and mixed Native/formal/isolated/demo configuration deny without a fallback.
specifications.title: Explicit routing is not authority

specifications.boundary: No fresh-DB issuance, fixture registry, process nonce, participant whitelist or formal-proof fixture substitutes ordinary current sources.
specifications.expected: An existing LOCAL preparation/Case/successful case.create Run/VERIFIED operation with current exact-domain participants and the explicit SYNTHETIC material service can enter. Nonempty business DB is allowed. Missing scope/source, unconfirmed material or wrong service denies.
specifications.title: Existing legal ordinary parent

specifications.boundary: Authority tables remain unchanged; executor whole-Run read still denies. Only the fixed task, exact service version, own offer/state/receipt are exposed; no automatic P1-P5 verification or whole-Case completion.
specifications.expected: The current responsible reviewer READ/REVIEW_ASSIGNED explicitly offers to an existing same-domain READ service_executor; that executor accepts/submits and the owner independently ACKs. Owner new business writes require READ/PREPARE/EXECUTE.
specifications.title: Original HTTP business chain and least information

specifications.boundary: Neither shared Python object nor issuance registry is needed. Restart/configuration never replaces the deadline with now+300 seconds or introduces a provider one-hour lifetime; current grants remain required.
specifications.expected: Recreated configured_app and a separately restarted worker see the same original UUIDs, versions, fingerprints and first timestamps after OFFER/ACCEPT/SUBMIT/OPEN/READ. The persisted first OFFER deadline remains identical.
specifications.title: Independent restart preserves original facts

specifications.boundary: Recovery is bound to exact original proof/coordinates, exposes uncertainty when not observed, and does not automatically POST ACCEPT/SUBMIT/ACK/VERIFY.
specifications.expected: Within the original allowed authorization/time boundary an identical original-key replay preserves its original event and creates no extra row. A different body conflicts. Terminal/expired states and a fresh key cannot create a second OFFER or renew the first deadline.
specifications.title: Keys and one offer

specifications.boundary: No authority write, fixture-issued CaseStep dependency, old-isolated adoption or suppression of foreign intent.
specifications.expected: An ordinary API may stop before delivery; a fresh original worker consumes the persisted ordinary event using current authorization. Later worker restarts and a fresh API preserve one inbox item per event/recipient and the original OPEN/READ times.
specifications.title: Fresh original worker consumes ordinary history

specifications.boundary: Marker text alone grants nothing. Rejected business calls have no event/outbox delta and no rejected-old-handler fallback.
specifications.expected: Live/expired ISOLATED marker, legacy dispatch/receipt, mixed/unknown/damaged marker deny ordinary read/write or remain quarantined in consumption. Ordinary mode never converts or relabels their history.
specifications.title: Old and corrupt protocols remain isolated

specifications.boundary: No new Run grant, history deletion or fallback from a Native/legacy denial. Detection relies on persisted surviving records, not an in-memory tainted_runs set; arbitrary trusted-admin deletion of history is outside this claim.
specifications.expected: Any surviving active/inactive run_assignment row or Native history denies ordinary actions, including contamination added after OFFER and checked by a new process.
specifications.title: Persisted Run/Native exclusions survive restart

specifications.boundary: A stale executor action or ACK denies and rolls back; implementation must not overwrite old proof with a restored current generation.
specifications.expected: Revoke/restore READ/PREPARE/REVIEW_ASSIGNED/EXECUTE or principal role/domain/generation across a restart never revives an old offer. Exact current scope and the original generation are required for new business actions.
specifications.title: Current permission and generation ABA

specifications.boundary: Currently authorized owner/reviewer may retain the contract minimum history; no new key, reassignment or process recreation bypasses changed-source rejection for new business actions.
specifications.expected: Material revision/hash or exact catalogue hash/xmin changes, including restore to apparently equal content, cannot bless the old offer or renew it in a fresh process.
specifications.title: Material and catalogue ABA

specifications.boundary: No per-request participants are stored as mutable shared service state. A failed or skipped candidate in Case A cannot poison the final checks for Case B.
specifications.expected: Two Cases with different participants interleaved through one API service/Store retain exact own Case/Run/preparation bindings for OFFER/read/ACCEPT/recovery/consume. Cross-Case actor/key/ID swaps deny or conflict.
specifications.title: Concurrent Case context separation

specifications.boundary: Malformed/edited deadline is rejected. A final admission check after locks is not claimed to be a physical COMMIT-instant atomic expiry guarantee.
specifications.expected: The first OFFER persists a database-clock deadline at most 300 seconds after its birth. ACCEPT/SUBMIT/ACK require that original deadline and generations; retry, ACCEPT, restart, revoke/restore or configuration never extends it.
specifications.title: First database deadline

specifications.boundary: Denied business or inbox commands do not commit their event or read timestamp. Busy/faulted delivery preserves the pending intent. Valid proven delivery may legitimately suppress a currently unauthorized recipient.
specifications.expected: A supported owned parent/inbox/outbox/auth lock wait crossing expiry, revocation or source change is followed by current token/authority/source checks and, for new business actions, the original deadline check.
specifications.title: Final check after lock waits

specifications.boundary: WITHDRAW does not require beneficiary READ or old-material freshness. Original accepted receipt/events remain historical. Executor read/write denies after expiry/termination; new business writes still require owner EXECUTE and the original deadline/generations.
specifications.expected: Current owner history needs READ/PREPARE without EXECUTE; reviewer history needs READ/REVIEW_ASSIGNED. History, OPEN/MARK_READ and current reviewer WITHDRAW do not inherit the offer 300-second deadline or isolated provider one-hour lifetime.
specifications.title: Ordinary history and withdrawal lifetime

specifications.boundary: Routing is not authorization. Unknown/damaged/foreign intent remains pending; only a complete own source proof can be delivered/suppressed. Cursor scope cannot cross protocol/authority boundaries. Bounded False does not prove exhaustion.
specifications.expected: Ordinary/default/old-isolated/foreign lanes are separated before a bounded LIMIT, consistently for API and worker. A foreign prefix must not starve an eligible own event; markerless followups still follow their original lineage.
specifications.title: Before-LIMIT lane separation

specifications.boundary: Corrupt payload/column/type/binding or unknown-key wrong coordinates refuse without 500 or partial-hash authorization; immutable event prefixes remain unchanged.
specifications.expected: OFFER1, ACCEPT2 to receipt CREATE, DECLINE/WITHDRAW and SUBMIT/recovery retain exact original typed actor/reason/revision/Case/Run/dispatch/receipt UUID/hash/version proof. A false OFFER2 cannot borrow the first marker.
specifications.title: Strict original event and recovery proofs

specifications.boundary: Only minimum CaseStep information appears, with no goal/material/facts/other executor data, no whole-Run access claim and no automatic POST. Node VM evidence is not a real-browser claim.
specifications.expected: Original complete HTML under ordinary configured_app navigates list/row/buttons to explicit OFFER, own ACCEPT/SUBMIT, independent ACK, notice OPEN and separate MARK_READ with actual HTTP. A late success/403 or ABA cannot restore stale private context or clear a newer recovery handle.
specifications.title: Original full-page controls and late responses

specifications.boundary: Startup must not seed/migrate/repair authority, create credentials or install host policy. Do not rerun/transfer the prior69 or129 matrices. Real browser, Windows, formal AT35, real sources/business/models and external messages remain NOT_RUN.
specifications.expected: Later bounded evidence must use an actual configured_app child process plus the original worker process, restricted app DSN, and only preboot original owned fixture principals/grants/catalogue. Runtime business is created by original HTTP, without CaseStep fixture issuance or owner.assign_status.
specifications.title: Execution provenance and allowed setup
